annotations.title: UK company check by name or number (Companies House)

description: Verify a UK business on the official Companies House register by company NAME or NUMBER: legal name, status (active, dissolved, liquidation), type, incorporation date, registered address, SIC codes, accounts overdue, charges, insolvency history and current directors. Use for KYB, supplier or customer checks, due diligence, or confirming a UK business is real and active. Name searches also return other close matches. Errors: 404 not found. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

number.description: Company number (e.g. 00445790) or company name (e.g. Tesco PLC)
